title: 第5章 荒原第6章 呼吸法
content_zh:
无星无月的夜，郊外的土路伸手不见五指。
引擎的轰鸣声打破了夜的寂静，四束橘黄色的车灯转过弯道，两辆中面一前一后在土路上蜿蜒前行。
陈冲在颠簸中慢慢皱紧眉头，然后猛的睁开眼睛。
这动静……是在车里？
周围有许多沉重的呼吸，污浊的空气充斥着车厢。
他悄然转动眼睛，隐约间看到旁边躺着的都是拳馆的学员，一动不动，似在沉睡。
回忆起昏迷之前发生了什么，他的心瞬间提了起来。
被绑架了？要到哪里去？
看窗外黑黢黢的景象，应该是出了城……荒原？！
陈冲眉头紧皱，对从未出过利川的他，或者每一个城里人来说，荒原就是罪恶无序，乃至神秘恐怖的代名词。
豹哥他们，是帮派分子，还是荒原上的原住民？
不管怎样，不能跟他们走……
陈冲念头急转，思考着对策。
然而此时身体仍然酸软，不要说对付于峰，就是跳车逃跑怕也不能够。
他心里有些焦急，眉头越蹙越紧。想要找找看车里有没有什么工具，然而车后半的货厢，周围全都是跟他一样被绑架的学员，什么有用的都没看见。
目光转动间，陈冲突然浑身一僵。
车中排的座位上，一双顶到车顶的深沉眼睛不知何时转了过来，正在和他对视。
“老于，看啥呢？”
前排传来豹哥的声音。
这是于峰……陈冲心中一沉，不知道什么时候被他发现自己醒了过来。

正不知道会有什么后果，他就听到于峰低沉的声音
“没什么。”
“行，看着点咱的人才，这路真几把烂，别给他们颠醒了。”
“我知道。”
没有举报我？
陈冲正有些诧异，就看到那双眼睛似再度深深盯了自己一眼，竟然转了回去。
他一片茫然，然而既然已经被发现，他更不敢有多余的动作，就这么跟着面包车摇摇晃晃，摇了数个小时，摇到天蒙蒙亮，摇进一座小镇。
最高不足三层的自建房和棚屋，掉了一半的门店招牌，路边浑浑噩噩的乞丐，还有卷帘门上随处可见的弹孔。
看到窗外破破烂烂如同城乡结合部的景象，陈冲面色阴沉。
聚居地……
果然是到荒原的聚居地上来了。
两扇大铁栅门缓缓拉开。
面包车拐进一处厂房，然后吱的一声在空地上停了下来。
车上的壮汉们都下了车，然后拿着手持气罐，往车里喷入刺鼻的气体。
一片痛苦的咳嗽，学员们纷纷醒来。
陈冲屏住呼吸，也装作刚刚苏醒一般下车，和懵懂的学员们一起打量起周围的环境。
“这是哪儿？是哪座工厂吗？”
“豹哥，我昨晚喝醉了吗？这是咱们特训的地方？”
穿着军绿色大衣的矮胖子摸了摸脑袋，笑眯眯道
“呵呵，这么说也行。”
content_en:
On a starless and moonless night, the dirt roads in the suburbs were almost invisible.
The roar of the engine broke the silence of the night, four beams of orange car lights turned the corner, and the two cars, one behind the other, meandered on the dirt road.
Chen Chong slowly frowned during the bumps, and then opened his eyes suddenly.
This movement...is it in the car?
There were many heavy breathings around, and the dirty air filled the car.
He quietly rolled his eyes and vaguely saw that the students lying next to him were all students from the boxing gym, motionless, as if they were sleeping.
Recalling what happened before he fell into coma, his heart suddenly lifted.
Kidnapped? Where to go?
Looking at the dark scene outside the window, it must be out of the city...the wasteland? !
Chen Chong frowned. For him, who had never been out of Lichuan, or for every city dweller, the wasteland was synonymous with crime, disorder, and even mystery and terror.
Brother Bao and the others, are they gang members or aboriginal people in the wilderness?
No matter what, you can't go with them...
Chen Chong's thoughts changed rapidly and he was thinking about countermeasures.
However, his body was still weak at this time, not to mention dealing with Yu Feng, even jumping out of the car and running away was not possible.
He felt a little anxious, and his brows furrowed tighter and tighter. He wanted to look for any tools in the car, but the cargo compartment in the back half of the car was surrounded by students who were kidnapped like him, and he didn't see anything useful.
As his eyes turned, Chen Zhan suddenly froze.
In the middle row of the car, a pair of deep eyes reaching to the roof of the car turned around at some point and were looking at him.
"Lao Yu, what are you looking at?"
Brother Bao's voice came from the front row.
This is Yu Feng... Chen Chong's heart sank. He didn't know when he found out that he had woken up.
Just when he didn't know what the consequences would be, he heard Yu Feng's deep voice.
"Nothing."
"Okay, look at our talents, this road is really bad, don't let them wake up."
"I know."
Didn't report me?
Chen Chongzheng was a little surprised when he saw those eyes staring deeply at him again and turned back.
He was at a loss, but now that he had been discovered, he didn't dare to make any unnecessary moves. He just followed the van and swayed for several hours, until it was dark and it entered a small town.
Self-built houses and shacks with a maximum height of less than three floors, half of the store signs missing, beggars on the roadside, and bullet holes can be seen everywhere on the rolling shutter doors.
Chen Chong looked gloomy when he saw the shabby scene outside the window that resembled the urban-rural fringe.
Settlement…
Sure enough, we came to the settlement in the wasteland.
Two large iron gates slowly opened.
The van turned into a factory building and then stopped in the open space with a squeak.
The strong men in the car got out of the car and then used hand-held gas cans to spray pungent gas into the car.
There was a painful cough, and the students woke up one after another.
Chen Chong held his breath and pretended to have just woken up. He got out of the car and looked at the surrounding environment with the ignorant students.
"Where is this? Which factory is it?"
"Brother Bao, was I drunk last night? This is our special training place?"
The short fat man in a military green coat touched his head and said with a smile.
"Haha, that's okay too."
